subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Must this PR provide an after-fix official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal delivery artifact before merge, or should maintainers explicitly waive that external-provider proof?
rationale: The source design and focused tests are persuasive, but repository policy requires live external-API verification and the existing proof exercises only the pre-fix Telegram symptom and unchanged Ollama routes.

options.title: Require official-provider proof
options.body: Capture a redacted Telegram transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing an after-fix official MiniMax delivery without the marker before merge.

options.title: Explicitly waive live proof
options.body: Accept the source, failing-first coverage, and Ollama isolation evidence as sufficient despite the missing official-provider after-fix run.

recommendation.title: Require official-provider proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted Telegram transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing an after-fix official MiniMax delivery without the marker before merge.
